scope: Reconciled PF231401 lower carrier bar exterior: central formed ledge, two folded-back lips, narrower round-end tabs and five real bores. Captive nuts, welds, metric forming and installed fit remain separate/unqualified.

source_pose_groups.crosland: One oblique rear pose, two exposure images
source_pose_groups.matriz: Distinct frontal pose with rubber dampers and central boot

observations: Distinct front pose shows a taller central formed ledge than lateral tabs
Oblique rear pose shows upper/lower returns and two captive nuts, kept separate here
Five-hole roles retained; outer nominal centres stay at+/-75mm for revised original game plate comparison

authored_estimates.method: Bounded original finite-sheet profile from related front/rear product poses, no measured dimensions

rejected_predecessor: Flat constant-height crossbar-v1 retained as superseded study
remaining: Captive nut exemplar and mounting seat
Exact dimensions, forming and current RDC installation
Edge UV strip layout before future grain/normal textures; current clean paint uses none
